scope: Segment 123 fully Field-Separator-delimited tokenization/cryptogram data segment (CAVV, Token Requestor ID, Token PAN Suffix, Cryptogram Token Data, SafeKey, TAVV)

rules.title: Segment Type is fixed value 123 (Element 85), Device-sourced
Segment Length (Element 84) includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators, Device-sourced
Segment 123 maximum length is 186 alphanumeric characters; originates at the Device
All fields are Field-Separator-delimited, including unpopulated fields (the separator is still sent)
Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data, and on transactions that include MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data
Token PAN Suffix (Element 197, 4 chars, Conditional, Issuer/Authorizer-sourced) — the last 4 digits of the cardholder PAN — is returned in the response only if supplied by the authorizer
CAVV, Revised Format (Element 195, 20 chars, Optional, Device-sourced) identifies Verified By Visa data with an Authentication Tracking Number (ATN) replacing XID
Cryptogram Token Data (Element 202) length is 28 or 56 bytes — Block A alone, or Block A and B combined

SafeKey Data (Element 203, 58 chars) is composed of a fixed 'SK' indicator (2 bytes), AEVV (28 bytes), and AESK Transaction Identifier (28 bytes); unused 28-byte portions must be space-filled rather than omitted
TAVV Cryptogram (Element 237, 28 bytes, base64 alphabet a-z/A-Z/0-9/+/=// ) may only be populated by the merchant during the transaction request, not the response

When both MasterCard DSRP cryptogram and SecureCode/Identity Check 3DS AAV are present in the same request, the AAV must be carried in Segment 111 Table ID 36 (UCAF) and the Token/DSRP cryptogram must be carried in Segment 123 Element 237 (TAVV) — the two fields are not interchangeable and both may be required simultaneously
rules.note: When both are present, UCAF Security Level Code positions 1-2 must equal '21' (Channel Encrypted) per the cross-reference at line ~36013.
